name: Progress Software Corporation
upcoming_dates: 2026-09-30 | earnings | Fiscal Q3 2026 financial results and conference call 5pm ET | https://investors.progress.com/news-releases/news-release-details/progress-software-report-third-quarter-2026-financial-results | primary
product: The AI-ready data layer: Domo cloud-native AI and data platform (1000+ connectors, agentic orchestration, governance) plus Progress Data Platform (MarkLogic, Semaphore, Agentic RAG). Demand is enterprises needing trusted, governed data context and control for AI deployments (SEC 8-K EX-99.1, 2026-09-22).
demand: Volume and mix, not price. Q2 FY26 software licenses rose 36pct yoy to $68.98M while maintenance, SaaS and services fell 1pct to $184.49M; ARR plus 2pct cc; net retention 100pct (SEC EX-99.1, 2026-06-30). Growth is new AI-product and license deals, not broad price increases.
pricing_power: Consumption-model revenue plus integration cost. FY26 guided amortization of acquired intangibles is $137.3M and stock-based comp $73.5M; Q2 G&A SBC rose 39pct yoy (SEC EX-99.1, 2026-06-30). If ARR growth stays near 2pct or license mix reverses to lower-margin SaaS, the 39pct non-GAAP operating margin compresses.
competition: Substitutes are hyperscaler-native and open-source: AWS Glue and QuickSight, Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, plus dbt, Airflow and Metabase stacks. No close Chinese data-platform substitute was found in sources read; Progress and Domo compete on governance and connectors, not price.
market_strategy: 2026-07-22 CEO Yogesh Gupta said the deal delivers the context and control for trusted AI, financed with cash and the revolver, closing within FY2026. Same date, Progress promised fiscal Q3 revenue and non-GAAP EPS within or above the high end of prior guidance (SEC 8-K EX-99.1).
bull: Domo closed 2026-09-22 inside FY26, adding 2400+ customers and ~$318M TTM revenue; Q2 FY26 revenue $253M beat with FY26 guidance raised and DA Davidson raised Buy to $55 on 2026-08-12.
bear: ARR grew only 2pct cc with net retention 100pct; recurring revenue fell 1pct; 2.9x net leverage after a $400M cash deal; Oppenheimer lowered to $50 on 2026-07-01; integration and consumption-margin risk.
falsifier: The 2026-09-30 Q3 print: revenue below the $244-250M high end or non-GAAP EPS below $1.59 would prove the bull case wrong.

web_bottleneck: Progress relieves the enterprise AI data-readiness bottleneck: fragmented data plus missing governance and context. Its own bottleneck is integration plus slow recurring growth, with ARR up only 2pct cc and net retention 100pct (2026-06-30), while de-levering 2.9x net leverage after a $400M cash deal (2026-09-22).
web_who_benefits_next: Cloud data warehouse partners and Domo ecosystem partners, systems integrators and Progress cross-sell into 200K+ organizations. Named Summit participants include AWS, Microsoft, Boeing, Moody's and Boston Consulting Group (IR PR, 2026-09-09). Domo brand and marks transfer to Progress (2026-09-22).
web_who_loses: Rival BI and analytics vendors lose pull as Progress bundles AI-ready data: Microsoft Power BI, Salesforce Tableau, Qlik and pure-play data platform firms. Domo Inc. itself sold its platform, keeps listing under a new name and ticker post-closing (SEC 8-K EX-99.2, 2026-07-22; EX-99.1, 2026-09-22).

web_ceo_promised: 2026-07-22 CEO Yogesh Gupta said the deal delivers the context and control for trusted AI, financed with cash and the revolver, closing within FY2026. Same date, Progress promised fiscal Q3 revenue and non-GAAP EPS within or above the high end of prior guidance (SEC 8-K EX-99.1).
web_did_they_deliver: Yes partly. Q2 FY26 revenue $253M was ahead of expectations and FY26 guidance was raised (2026-06-30). The Domo deal closed 2026-09-22, inside FY2026, and net leverage fell to 2.9x. The at-or-above-high-end Q3 promise is unverified until 2026-09-30 (SEC 8-K, IR).
web_what_would_falsify: The 2026-09-30 Q3 print: revenue below the $244-250M high end, or non-GAAP EPS below $1.59, would falsify the claim that Q3 lands at or above the high end. Also net leverage above 3.0x, or declining Domo ARR, would break the deal thesis (SEC EX-99.1, 2026-07-22).
